# JBStaycation

> A quieter escape, just across the causeway. Private holiday houses in Johor Bahru, Malaysia, for Singapore families and groups. Host: Daniel (based in Singapore and JB; English, Malay and Chinese), WhatsApp +65 9006 2198 (https://wa.me/6590062198). Book directly through HitPay, the Airbnb listing or internet banking, in RM.

## Booking terms
- RM 500 per night per house is the weekday guideline price; RM 120 cleaning fee per stay; WhatsApp the host for group size or gatherings.
- Check-in 3pm, check-out 11am; self check-in details sent after a firm booking; early check-in or late checkout RM 100 an hour, subject to availability (waiver on request).
- Minimum stay 1 night (2 nights over Christmas Eve and Christmas Day). No cancellation; dates can be changed once.
- Gatherings need the host's approval; booking deposit about RM 600 to 1,200 depending on group size. Visitors allowed; quiet hours 11pm to 7am.
- Professionally cleaned after every checkout; fresh linen, towels and toiletries provided. Fire extinguisher under the kitchen sink; outdoor CCTV; the host is the emergency contact.
- Neither house has a swimming pool (pool tables only).

## Houses
- [Prima, Taman Nusantara Prima](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/jb-staycation/stays/prima-taman-nusantara-prima/): 19 Jalan Prima 3/1, Taman Nusantara Prima, Iskandar Puteri, Johor 79200, Malaysia. Up to 12 guests, RM 500 per night. A private landed house in Gelang Patah, Iskandar Puteri for up to 12 guests with a 7ft pool table in the living room, a mahjong table and parking for 8 cars, about 10 minutes from the Tuas Second Link (host estimate).
- [Landak Kawan Fun House, Taman Abad](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/jb-staycation/stays/landak-kawan-fun-house-taman-abad/): Jalan Landak Kawan 2, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru, Johor 80250, Malaysia. Up to 10 guests, RM 500 per night. A new double-storey landed fun house for up to 10 guests with an 8ft pool table, foosball, 2 dart boards, a mahjong table and a TV arcade, a 5-minute walk from KSL City Mall.
